scenes.causal_outcome: Because Levi can see the notice, the next scene must plan a shared repair schedule.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Expose the immediate cost of concealment and force Mara's first honest choice.
scenes.immediate_want: Mara wants Levi to accept one more vague promise without reading the warning.
scenes.obstacle: The empty ledger and his direct question block that escape.
scenes.visible_action: Mara opens the sealed warning and sets it beside the open ledger on the table.
scenes.consequential_choice: She gives up control of the information.
scenes.turn_trigger: Putting the notice where Levi can read it.

spoken_dialogue.text: If I lock that door, their checks bounce tomorrow.
I hid the notice. I thought I could fix it alone.
Then why is the ledger empty tonight?

sung_lyrics.text: I kept the light on, kept the truth outside.
Open the book and let us stand on your side.

scenes.subtext_and_behavior: She admits the fact before naming the feeling, and stills her hands on the open page.
sound_music_cues: Fan clicks off before the first line; restrained low instrumental bed under speech.
scenes.framing_movement_intent: Medium close-up inside the door, then insert on the opening envelope, slow push over the exposed notice.
scenes.transition: Match-cut from the shared ledger to the next scene's first written action.
